firstMessage.content:
Hi everyone! First time competing on Kaggle so still learning, but here’s what I tried:

Approach: Fine tuned DistilBERT (keras/distil_bert_base_en_uncased) on the training set with 5-fold stratified cross-validation.

Config: MAX_LEN=256, BATCH_SIZE=16, EPOCHS=4, LR=2e-5

Result: OOF balanced accuracy ~0.2515

The model is still learning to distinguish between models from the same provider (e.g. the different GPT-5.6 variants are tricky). Curious if others are finding stylometric features useful on top of embeddings, or going purely with transformers.

Happy to hear any tips!
